description: Backend-neutral type descriptor tests — verifies that IR dump produces spec-format RuntimeTypeDescriptor strings for all DEAL types.

tests.name: primitive-null
tests.description: Null literal type descriptor in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: null = null; return; }

tests.name: primitive-boolean
tests.description: Boolean literal type in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: boolean = true; return; }

tests.name: primitive-int
tests.description: Int literal type in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: int = 42; return; }

tests.name: primitive-number
tests.description: Number literal type in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: number = 3.14; return; }

tests.name: primitive-string
tests.description: String literal type in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let x: string = "hello"; return; }

tests.name: primitive-table
tests.description: Table literal type in IR
tests.source: function f(): null { let t: table = {}; return; }

tests.name: array-int-spec-format
tests.description: Array of int uses spec [int] format on param
tests.source: function f(a: int[]): null { return; }

tests.name: array-string-spec-format
tests.description: Array of string uses spec [string] format on param
tests.source: function f(a: string[]): null { return; }

tests.name: nested-array-spec-format
tests.description: Nested array uses spec [[int]] format on param
tests.source: function f(a: int[][]): null { return; }

tests.name: nullable-int-spec-format
tests.description: Nullable int param uses spec ?int format
tests.source: function f(n: int | null): null { return; }

tests.name: nullable-string-spec-format
tests.description: Nullable string param uses spec ?string format
tests.source: function f(n: string | null): null { return; }

tests.name: class-descriptor-spec-format
tests.description: Class type uses @module/Class format on resolved expression

tests.name: nullable-class-descriptor
tests.description: Nullable class param uses ?ClassName format
tests.source:
class User { name: string = ""; }
function f(u: User | null): null { return; }

tests.name: nullable-array-param
tests.description: Nullable array param uses ?[int] format
tests.source: function f(a: int[] | null): null { return; }

tests.name: array-of-nullable-int
tests.description: Array of nullable int param uses [?int]
tests.source: function f(a: (int | null)[]): null { return; }

tests.name: no-legacy-format
tests.description: IR dump never uses legacy T[] or T|null format
tests.source: function f(a: int[], b: int | null, c: string | null, d: string[]): null { return; }

tests.name: function-type-descriptor-multi-arg
tests.description: Function type (int,int)->int appears in IR for function-typed ident
tests.source:
function add(a: int, b: int): int { return a + b; }
let f: (a: int, b: int) => int = add;

tests.name: function-type-descriptor-null-return
tests.description: Function type ()->null appears in IR for function-typed ident
tests.source:
function noop(): null { return; }
let f: () => null = noop;

tests.name: function-type-descriptor-nullable-return
tests.description: Function type (int)->?string appears in IR for nullable-return function
tests.source:
function maybe(x: int): int | null { if (x === 0) { return null; } return x; }
let f: (x: int) => int | null = maybe;

tests.name: function-type-descriptor-mixed-params
tests.description: Function type (int,string)->boolean appears in IR for mixed-param function
tests.source:
function check(x: int, s: string): boolean { return true; }
let f: (x: int, s: string) => boolean = check;

tests.name: function-type-descriptor-array-param
tests.description: Function type ([int])->int appears in IR for array-param function
tests.source:
function head(xs: int[]): int { return xs[0]; }
let f: (xs: int[]) => int = head;

tests.name: async-function-descriptor
tests.description: Async function descriptor uses async prefix in IR
tests.source:
async function fetch(x: int): string { return "data"; }
let f: async (x: int) => string = fetch;
